key_notes: Key 1 (t=0.94s): Initial archival pose of square; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=2.06s): Mid-sequence articulation of square; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=3.3s): Peak dynamic extension of square over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.54s): Follow-through and settle of square with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of square (0.94s..4.54s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
